external_references.supports: Publisher labels Gomorrah and reports HTTP exfiltration/C2 in its 2020 sandbox analysis. This project did not execute the sample.
Browser credential access mapping; not every DPAPI call is T1555.004.

facts.text: Code opens Opera/Chrome Login Data through SQLiteHandler, reads logins and retrieves username/password fields; the password value is passed to Decrypt.
facts.scope: Static capability; no successful credential recovery was observed in this project.

facts.text: upload_passwords uses WebClient.UploadFile on the Passwords path with urlbot plus /logs.php?hwid= and HWID().
facts.scope: The upload operation is present. The variable name alone does not establish all upstream data flow.

facts.text: Screenshot code calls CopyFromScreen and saves the image in PNG format to path_screenshot.
facts.scope: Static implemented capture capability; no screenshot was taken by the project.

facts.text: upload_screenshot builds /screen.php?hwid= and passes path_screenshot to UploadFile.
facts.scope: Static outbound-file capability. Exact destination still requires configuration extraction.

facts.text: Configuration reads its own executable, splits content on |FS| and assigns element 1 to urlbot.
facts.scope: Config recovery is incomplete until the corresponding data bytes are independently extracted.

facts.text: The t.me/th3darkly strings here occur in author-credit text, not in the UploadFile destination expressions.
facts.scope: Do not map these URL literals to webhook exfiltration. A t.me link is not automatically a Telegram bot API token or exfiltration channel.

exclusions: No generic absence-of-behavior claims are justified by the selected excerpts.
This is a development reference subset, not complete ground truth or an unseen test set.
T1041 requires established C2 channel evidence; the mere UploadFile API is insufficient for that mapping.
